name: M5.Signature.ordinary_gcd_properties
statement: ∀ a b : M5.BinaryPolynomial, a.coeff 0 = 1 → b.coeff 0 = 1 → (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b).Monic ∧ (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b).coeff 0 = 1 ∧ (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b).natDegree ≤ b.natDegree
context:
theorem M5.Signature.binary_monic : ∀ P : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ≠ 0 → P.Monic := by
  change ∀ P : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ≠ 0 → P.Monic
  intro P hP
  have h : ∀ c : ZMod 2, c ≠ 0 → c = 1 := by decide
  change P.leadingCoeff = 1
  exact h P.leadingCoeff (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP)

theorem M5.Signature.divisor_constant_one : ∀ P a : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ∣ a → a.coeff 0 = 1 → P.coeff 0 = 1 := by
  change ∀ P a : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ∣ a → a.coeff 0 = 1 → P.coeff 0 = 1
  intro P a hdiv ha
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hdiv
  rw [Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero] at ha
  have h : ∀ c d : ZMod 2, c * d = 1 → c = 1 := by decide
  exact h (P.coeff 0) (q.coeff 0) ha
guidance: Anchored coefficients imply a and b nonzero. EuclideanDomain.gcd_eq_zero_iff gives nonzero gcd. Apply binary_monic, divisor_constant_one with gcd_dvd_left, and Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd using b nonzero and gcd_dvd_right. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.
